items.item_text: Please list ALL required licenses/qualifications on your application and resume. Any applications missing the necessary requirements will not be considered.*
R. EEG T. Certification – required within the first 6 months of employment

The EEG Technologist is responsible for performing high-quality electroencephalographic (EEG) studies with minimal supervision, demonstrating proficiency in EEG acquisition, artifact identification, and troubleshooting. The incumbent must be able to accurately recognize and communicate EEG findings to clinical faculty and collaborate effectively with the healthcare team.

The EEG Technologist must demonstrate adaptability and a willingness to learn and perform a variety of EEG procedures, including adult and pediatric telemetry monitoring, continuous EEG monitoring in the Intensive Care Unit (ICU), outpatient EEG studies, and portable bedside examinations.

The incumbent is required to obtain the Registered Electroencephalographic Technologist (R. EEG T.) credential within the first six months of employment. Based on departmental and operational needs, the EEG Technologist may be required to provide coverage at other UCLA Health locations and participate in the departmental on-call rotation.
